_comment: Mutation-score floors (#532). Up-only under test:ratchet. Seeded ~2–3pt below measured Stryker on property-defended mutate sets (2026-07-23/24): vault custody 100%; client intents+payload-hash ~73.5%; automation scheduler ~82%; blob-format CBSF 100%; protocol judge ~76.3%; tunnel pure wire ~81.5%; app-engine cost formula 100%. Re-seeded 2026-07-31 (#656 Layer 1C): backup 97.09% measured locally after the WAL-addressing + seal/derive mutation-kill campaign (was 46.07%, below _absoluteWeaknessBelow); gateway allowed-hosts 78.79% and agent-runtime low-priority 91.89% taken from the last green nightly mutation lane (e2e.yml run 30524995032, 2026-07-30T08:10Z), replacing the conservative #545 D6 placeholders. Ratcheted 2026-07-31 (#656 Layer 3) to (measured − 2/3) against that same nightly run: protocol 85.71 → 83, tunnel 81.48 → 79, automation 83.84 → 81, client-replica 74.14 → 72. vault / blob-format / app-engine measured 100 and their 97 floors are already (measured − 3), so they are unchanged. #656 CORRECTION (2026-07-31, PR #661 CI run 30616999454): packages/backup and packages/blueprints were first seeded from LOCAL Stryker runs (97.09 and 88.52) and CI measured 85.47 and 77.46 — an ~11pt gap in both. Local darwin/arm64 and CI linux/x64 do not agree on these two mutate sets, so the floor is re-seeded ~3pt under the CI number, because CI is the lane that enforces it. Seeding from the developer's own machine is precisely the author-asserted claim this issue exists to eliminate.
_layer3Comment: #656 Layer 3 extended the adversary from 10 seeds to 15. Each new floor is (first measured − 2/3) AFTER the laws in that package's *-properties / *-contract test file landed; the score before those laws is recorded too, because the gap is the finding: blueprints 56.97 → 88.52 (floor 86); time-engine 57.90 → 77.87 (floor 75); cli 61.69 → 92.21 (floor 90); design-tokens 0.00 → 96.00 (floor 93 — the 0.00 is literal: the only css test called toCss() at module scope, and `ignoreStatic` discards static mutants, so the generator contributed zero mutants to measure); oauth-worker 57.75 → 90.85 (floor 88, pure fail-closed guard line range only). #725 adds seed 16: packages/model-runtime (named enrichment-service until #753 renamed it) tokenizer/CTC/NMS pure math measured 83.00 locally, floor 80 (measured − 3). Mutate paths and the reasoning for what was left out live in each package's stryker.config.mjs.
_w2Comment: #839 W2-1 extends the adversary from 16 seeds to 24, over the blueprint APP layer (tasks / notes / agenda / _shared pending-overlay, selection, triage, search-scaffold) and the phone (apps/mobile src/lib). EVERY FLOOR ADDED BY THIS CHANGE IS PROVISIONAL-LOCAL: it was seeded from a LOCAL linux/x64 Stryker run and NOT from CI, which this file's header says is the only lane a floor may be seeded from. To stay honest about that, each provisional floor is (local measured − 11) rather than the usual (measured − 2/3) — 11 points is the local/CI gap #656 measured on packages/backup and packages/blueprints, applied in the pessimistic direction because the direction of that gap was never verified. Re-seed each of these to (CI measured − 3) on the first green nightly mutation lane that includes them, and delete this note when that happens. Local measurements (2026-08-21, node 24 linux/x64): tasks 72.31 → 61; notes 72.18 → 61; agenda 85.52 → 74 (re-measured 79.30 after W3-C's format-locale suite let format.ts join the mutate set — the floor stays 74, seeded from the narrower set, and still holds against the wider one); pending-overlay 96.79 → 85; selection 76.42 → 65; triage 73.08 → 62; search-scaffold 95.65 → 84; mobile 73.00 → 62. Two of those numbers are the finding rather than the baseline: pending-overlay measured 48.23 against its existing suite alone — below _absoluteWeaknessBelow — and reached 96.79 only after apps/_shared/pending-overlay-law.test.ts landed in the same change; notes/logic.ts and agenda/logic.ts had NO test at all before it, and now measure 82.30 and 89.87. Deliberately NOT seeded: apps/_shared/placement-registry.ts and apps/_shared/pending-projections.ts (module-scope const tables — `ignoreStatic` discards their mutants, so they score 0 and say nothing), apps/mobile src/lib/notification-model.ts (57.14 local, 24 of 98 mutants never executed by its own suite) and src/lib/phone-link-parse.ts (60.71 local, the base64url transport decode unasserted). apps/_shared/untrusted.ts is no longer in this deliberately-unseeded list — #864 W2 seeded it once a node-side suite existed; see _w864Comment.
_w864Comment: #864 W2 (M4) adds seed 25: packages/blueprints/apps/_shared/untrusted — the shell's render boundary (the displayText control/bidi scrubber plus the safeExternal / safeMedia / safeDocument / safeBackgroundImage URL sinks). A node-side property suite (apps/_shared/untrusted-properties.test.ts: four tagged laws over arbitrary unicode + fc.webUrl() + an adversarial scheme alphabet, plus two it.fails boundary pins) now exists precisely so Stryker's vitest runner can measure the module — its only prior suite (src/untrusted-rendering.test.ts) is jsdom, which the runner dry-runs as "No tests were executed"; that is why the 'Deliberately NOT seeded … untrusted.ts' clause has been struck from _w2Comment. PROVISIONAL-LOCAL exactly like every _w2Comment floor: local (2026-08-25, node 24 linux/x64) measured 95.14 → floor 84 (measured − 11, the same pessimistic local/CI gap, because CI has not measured it yet). The 7 survivors are the two 16 MiB media/document length caps (untestable without a 16 MiB input) and two equivalent mutants (the empty-string sentinel and the scheme-regex anchor, both re-null via the URL parse). Re-seed to (CI measured − 3) on the first green nightly mutation lane that includes it, and delete this note when that happens.
_w892Comment: #892 Phase 2 widens the apps/mobile seed from five pure src/lib modules to nine, adding the two trees the #890 audit found undefended: src/lib/upload/ (transfer-policy.ts, reconcile-gate.ts) and src/lib/replica/ (background-scopes.ts, mobile-intent-id.ts). The audit's exhibit was that neither the transfer-policy scope loop nor the replica orphan check was inside ANY seed's watch list, so two tests that could not fail were invisible to the one gate built to notice exactly that. THE FLOOR IS UNCHANGED AT 62. The wider set measures 72.31 local (2026-08-31, node 22 linux/x64) against 73.00 for the narrower one, so (measured - 11) would be 61 and floors are tighten-only; 62 holds against 72.31 with margin and lowering it to match a provisional-local convention would be a weakening, not an accounting. Per-file, and recorded because it is the finding rather than the baseline: reconcile-gate.ts 100.00, transfer-policy.ts 73.21 (26 survivors), mobile-intent-id.ts 68.75 (8 survivors), background-scopes.ts 59.09 (8 survivors) - the last is below _absoluteWeaknessBelow as a FILE, which the seed-level floor does not see. Seeding it anyway is deliberate: excluding an under-defended module because it is under-defended is how these two trees came to have no adversary at all. Re-seed the whole seed to (CI measured - 3) on the first green mutation-canary or nightly run that includes the wider set.
